title: Game mode
description: modes/<id>/mode.yaml: a game mode, a way to play the packs' content (packages/game/modes: parseGameMode, docs/modding/modos.md).

name.description: The localization key of the mode's name.

description.description: The localization key of the mode's line in the mode list.

ruleset.description: The ruleset a new game of the mode starts with; one of rulesets.

rulesets.description: The rulesets the new game's rules screen may choose from; with one, the screen is not shown.

order.description: Where the mode goes in the mode list: lower first, then by id.
